The Sierra foothills, the coastal ranges, and the canyon and hillside rims around the metro areas.

sections.title: How the Score Works
sections.intro: The composite rebuilds the recipe of the licensed property-level models from public federal data.
sections.blurb: The commercial models it mirrors, the composite weights and the tier rules.

items.text: Verisk (formerly ISO). Scored 0-30: 0-1 low, 2-3 moderate, 4-12 high, 13-30 extreme. Built from slope, fuel and access.
Cotality (formerly CoreLogic). Scored 1-100 from satellite-based burn probability, fuel density and ember exposure.
Zesty.ai. Scored 1-10 by AI on aerial imagery of roof material, vegetation and defensible space.
ISO. Scored 1-10 on community fire protection: fire department capability, water supply and dispatch.
All four are licensed per property and not published by ZIP code. The composite here rebuilds the same recipe from public federal data on a 0-100 scale.

items.title: Composite Weights
items.foot: FEMA National Risk Index, December 2025, all 9,106 California census tracts. The wildfire fields rest on USDA Forest Service burn probability modeling.

Beverly Hills 90210 scores 51.3 (High). Santa Rosa 95404 scores 49.2 (High). Oakland 94611 scores 30.9 (Moderate, with one tract at 97).
San Francisco 94103 scores 0.9, downtown Los Angeles 90012 scores 18.9 and downtown San Diego 92101 scores 15.4. All are Low.

methods.title: Tracts to ZIP Codes
methods.text: FEMA National Risk Index (December 2025) for all 9,106 California census tracts, matched to 2020 Census ZIP Code Tabulation Areas. U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey 2020-2024 5-year estimates for housing weights and households.

methods.title: Composite Score
methods.text: NRI wildfire risk score (35%), share of homes in high-risk tracts (25%), building loss rate (15%), fire frequency (15%) and resilience gap (10%). Each tract counts toward a ZIP code in proportion to the housing units it contributes. Tiers follow the rules in the scoring section.

methods.title: Scope
methods.text: A ZIP-level screen for targeting. Carriers score each property with the commercial models above, and the CAL FIRE Fire Hazard Severity Zone maps (updated February-March 2025) carry the regulatory designations. A Low ZIP code can still contain higher-risk pockets.

methods.title: Comparison with Other Reports
methods.text: These tiers rank California ZIP codes on their own rules. They are not on the same scale as the wildfire tiers in other states' Home Risk Maps.
